name: Beetroot Ginger Shot
subtitle: earthy rather than sharp, and the one that stains

steps.text: Blend the beetroot and ginger with 100ml water until completely smooth. A blender needs longer here than it looks like it should.
Strain through a fine sieve or muslin, pressing hard. Beetroot pulp holds on to its juice.
Stir in the orange and lemon juice and the black salt.

storage: Two days refrigerated. It will stain a plastic jug permanently; use glass.

provenance.note: Beetroot juice is standard at Indian juice stalls, usually cut with carrot. The nitrates in it are the reason athletes drink it before an event.
